question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

When Mr. Bhanot was told a few years back that he needed to lose _____ or face health problems, he transformed his life with the _____ of a personal trainer.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"weight"** refers to a measure of how heavy something is. It is often used in the context of body weight or physical mass. (वजन)

 
 
• **Example: **She is trying to lose weight by following a healthy diet and exercising regularly.
 
 
 
• The word **"help"** means providing assistance or support to someone in need. (मदद)
